scope: Scientific saved-data checks from a clean ZIP extraction, publication regression records, source-to-PDF checks and complete visual review. Fresh runtime and measurement campaigns are retained separately.
archive_acceptance: CRC, exact extracted file inventory, all extracted bytes, root structure and standalone/archived PDF equality passed before verification. After adding these acceptance records, the final archive is extracted and checked again.
visual_review: All 12 main and 28 supplement pages inspected. All nine figures inspected in color and grayscale. Final reference columns balanced; the isolated supplement continuation was reunited with its paragraph. No remaining clipping, collisions or unreadable labels observed.
